summary: A2Z Cust2Mate furnished a Form 6-K supplementing its October 6, 2026 announcement that wholly owned subsidiary A2Z Advanced Solutions Ltd. completed the acquisition of all outstanding shares of Israel-based Heidia Ltd. from O. Gal Enterprises Ltd. Consideration is NIS 25,292,000 cash (subject to adjustments) plus 833,333 common shares, with up to NIS 20,000,000 in earnout cash tied to 2027-2028 revenues and a separate NIS 13,691,000 dividend from Heidia to seller. Shares are trustee-held and released in tranches through October 2029, with forfeiture and indemnity set-off provisions; watch earnout achievement and lock-up overhang.
